blocks.text:
Six schools attended by girls injured in mass stabbing miss out on £1m allocated for staff, counselling and specialist support

Families of girls injured in the Southport attack have said they are “horrified” that their daughters’ schools received no financial support after the atrocity while others were given “eye-watering sums”.

It emerged on Tuesday that seven schools attended by victims of the mass stabbing received £1m between them to pay for extra teaching staff, counselling and other specialist support.
